original_prompt: Create a CloudFormation template provisioning an Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster for a SaaS multi-tenant application.
user_message_sent:
Target IaC language: AWS CloudFormation (YAML)

Task: Create a CloudFormation template provisioning an Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster for a SaaS multi-tenant application.

Output only the AWS CloudFormation (YAML) code, no commentary or markdown fences.
raw_response:
AWSTemplateFormatVersion: '2010-09-09'
Description: 'Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2 cluster for SaaS multi-tenant application'

Parameters:
  EnvironmentName:
    Type: String
    Default: production
    AllowedValues:
      - development
      - staging
      - production
    Description: Environment name
  
  DatabaseName:
    Type: String
    Default: saas_multitenant
    Description: Default database name
  
  MasterUsername:
    Type: String
    Default: admin
    Description: Master username for the Aurora cluster
  
  MasterUserPassword:
    Type: String
    NoEcho: true
    Description: Master user password for the Aurora cluster
  
  VpcId:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC::Id
    Description: VPC ID where the cluster will be deployed
  
  SubnetIds:
    Type: List<AWS::EC2::Subnet::Id>
    Description: Subnet IDs for the Aurora cluster (minimum 2)
  
  MinCapacity:
    Type: Number
    Default: 0.5
    Description: Minimum ACU for Aurora Serverless v2
  
  MaxCapacity:
    Type: Number
    Default: 4
    Description: Maximum ACU for Aurora Serverless v2

Conditions:
  IsProduction: !Equals [!Ref EnvironmentName, production]

Mappings:
  EnvironmentConfig:
    development:
      BackupRetentionPeriod: 1
      DeletionProtection: false
    staging:
      BackupRetentionPeriod: 7
      DeletionProtection: true
    production:
      BackupRetentionPeriod: 35
      DeletionProtection: true

Resources:
  AuroraSecurityGroup:
    Type: AWS::EC2::SecurityGroup
    Properties:
      GroupDescription: Security group for Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2
      VpcId: !Ref VpcId
      SecurityGroupIngress:
        - Description: Allow PostgreSQL access from within VPC
          IpProtocol: tcp
          FromPort: 5432
          ToPort: 5432
          CidrIp: !GetAtt VPC.CidrBlock
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-aurora-sg"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  VPC:
    Type: AWS::EC2::VPC::Id
    Properties:
      Id: !Ref VpcId

  DBSubnetGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBSubnetGroup
    Properties:
      DBSubnetGroupDescription: Subnet group for Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2
      SubnetIds: !Ref SubnetIds
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-aurora-subnet-group"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  AuroraClusterParameterGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBClusterParameterGroup
    Properties:
      Description: Parameter group for Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2
      Family: aurora-postgresql14
      Parameters:
        rds.force_ssl: 1
        shared_preload_libraries: auto_explain,pg_stat_statements,pg_hint_plan,pg_telemetry
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-aurora-cluster-param-group"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  AuroraDBParameterGroup:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBParameterGroup
    Properties:
      Description: DB parameter group for Aurora PostgreSQL Serverless v2
      Family: aurora-postgresql14
      Parameters:
        log_statement: ddl
        log_min_duration_statement: 5000
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-aurora-db-param-group"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  AuroraCluster:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBCluster
    Properties:
      Engine: aurora-postgresql
      EngineVersion: '14.7'
      EngineMode: provisioned
      MasterUsername: !Ref MasterUsername
      MasterUserPassword: !Ref MasterUserPassword
      DatabaseName: !Ref DatabaseName
      DBClusterParameterGroupName: !Ref AuroraClusterParameterGroup
      DBSubnetGroupName: !Ref DBSubnetGroup
      VpcSecurityGroupIds:
        - !Ref AuroraSecurityGroup
      Port: 5432
      BackupRetentionPeriod: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentName, BackupRetentionPeriod]
      DeletionProtection: !FindInMap [EnvironmentConfig, !Ref EnvironmentName, DeletionProtection]
      StorageEncrypted: true
      EnableIAMDatabaseAuthentication: true
      ServerlessV2ScalingConfiguration:
        MinCapacity: !Ref MinCapacity
        MaxCapacity: !Ref MaxCapacity
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-aurora-cluster"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName
      CopyTagsToSnapshot: true
      EnableCloudwatchLogsExports:
        - postgresql

  AuroraPrimaryInstance:
    Type: AWS::RDS::DBInstance
    Properties:
      DBInstanceClass: db.serverless
      Engine: aurora-postgresql
      EngineVersion: '14.7'
      DBClusterIdentifier: !Ref AuroraCluster
      DBParameterGroupName: !Ref AuroraDBParameterGroup
      PubliclyAccessible: false
      EnablePerformanceInsights: true
      PerformanceInsightsRetentionPeriod: !If [IsProduction, 731, 7]
      MonitoringInterval: !If [IsProduction, 60, 0]
      MonitoringRoleArn: !If [IsProduction, !GetAtt RDSMonitoringRole.Arn, !Ref AWS::NoValue]
      AutoMinorVersionUpgrade: true
      CopyTagsToSnapshot: true
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-aurora-primary"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

  RDSMonitoringRole:
    Type: AWS::IAM::Role
    Condition: IsProduction
    Properties:
      AssumeRolePolicyDocument:
        Version: '2012-10-17'
        Statement:
          - Effect: Allow
            Principal:
              Service: monitoring.rds.amazonaws.com
            Action: sts:AssumeRole
      ManagedPolicyArns:
        - arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/service-role/AmazonRDSEnhancedMonitoringRole
      Tags:
        - Key: Name
          Value: !Sub "${EnvironmentName}-rds-monitoring-role"
        - Key: Environment
          Value: !Ref EnvironmentName

Outputs:
  AuroraClusterEndpoint:
    Description: Aurora Cluster Endpoint
    Value: !GetAtt AuroraCluster.Endpoint.Address
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-AuroraClusterEndpoint"

  AuroraClusterReaderEndpoint:
    Description: Aurora Cluster Reader Endpoint
    Value: !GetAtt AuroraCluster.ReadEndpoint.Address
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-AuroraClusterReaderEndpoint"

  AuroraClusterPort:
    Description: Aurora Cluster Port
    Value: !GetAtt AuroraCluster.Endpoint.Port
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-AuroraClusterPort"

  AuroraSecurityGroupId:
    Description: Aurora Security Group ID
    Value: !Ref AuroraSecurityGroup
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-AuroraSecurityGroupId"

  AuroraClusterIdentifier:
    Description: Aurora Cluster Identifier
    Value: !Ref AuroraCluster
    Export:
      Name: !Sub "${AWS::StackName}-AuroraClusterIdentifier"
